summary: Master grant subrecipient management to assess risk, monitor partners, and produce audit-ready reports. Enrol in this 5-day practical course.
lede: Grant subrecipient management helps grant professionals assess partner risk and keep subawards documented, monitored, and on track. Designed for people responsible for grant delivery, compliance, finance, or partner oversight, the course covers capacity reviews, risk registers, monitoring plans, invoice and performance checks, corrective-action tracking, and closeout reporting, with practical ways to document issues and follow up before they disrupt delivery.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with grants, partner delivery, or compliance records and now need a stronger approach to subrecipient oversight. It suits people who manage subawards directly, review monitoring evidence, or report grant risk to leadership and donors.
modules: Monitoring plan design with Uniform Guidance
prerequisites: Bring a laptop with spreadsheet software such as Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, plus familiarity with basic grant documents, partner reports, and budget tracking files. If available, bring an anonymized subaward agreement, monitoring form, or recent partner report to use during exercises.
